answer_2.quote: We apply it to a semantic segmentation task on generated imagery, comparing DAAM maps with annotation. We attain a 58.8-64.8 mean intersection over union (mIoU) score ... We also report pixel accuracy and dice score metrics.

answer_4.quote: We gathered human judgements... using a crowdsourcing platform (Amazon MTurk). We presented the generated image, the heat map, and the prompt... and asked expert workers to rate how well the highlighting reflects the word on a five‑point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rated the relevance of the heat map to the target word using categories: bad, poor, fair, good, excellent, and could also flag abstract words or poor images.
criteria: relevance of heat map to target word
